model_revision_policy: resolved and pinned to Hugging Face commit 12af15fef9d0ac838c3f475bfbbf26d2060dd4f5 after the compatibility smoke test; no embeddings existed when layer/chunk/classifier choices were preregistered

audio.chunk_positions: evenly spaced from 5% to 85% of valid start range; zero-pad only if recording is shorter than one chunk

selection: For each locked outer fold, select representation and C using deterministic three-fold stratified CV on that outer training partition only. Refit on the complete outer training partition and predict the untouched outer test partition once.
